text:
When the map of the stage is incorporated

into the map of what lies beyond the stage

When the word has settled into the thing

and is objectively conditioned by the order of things


When language at last has sedimented

in the likeness, for example, of ancient minerals

and when style has clearly crystallized

in the likeness, for example, of transparent quartz


When communication

(in the likeness, for example, of the words used:

incorporated, settled, sedimented, crystallized)

is caught in a trap


then choice, dreams, history must

(in the likeness, for example, of dark utopias)

write themselves between the lines

(in the likeness, for example, of the youngest guerrilla)

translation.title: When the Map of the Stage Is Incorporated…
